MediaMTX AOM AV1 RTMP / WHIP / HLS compatibility patch
==========================================================

Bundled application base:
  MediaMTX v1.19.3

Patched dependency base:
  github.com/bluenviron/gortmplib v0.4.1

Build version:
  v1.19.3-r8

Problems fixed:
  1. FFmpeg and OBS AOM AV1 can emit an Enhanced RTMP video sequence-start
     containing only the AV1 FourCC ("av01"). Upstream gortmplib v0.4.1
     attempts to decode the empty av1C body and closes the publisher with EOF.
  2. OBS 32.2.1 uses libdatachannel v0.24.2. Its AV1 RTP packetizer can retain
     the OBU size field, mishandle extension headers, or omit the OBU base
     header. MediaMTX then either destroys the HLS muxer, returns an empty 500,
     or cannot recognize AV1 random-access units.
  3. Some AV1 senders do not repeat the sequence header on every key frame.
     gohlslib uses the sequence header as its AV1 random-access marker, so the
     HLS segment can grow until hlsSegmentMaxSize is reached.

Patch:
  1. Accept a five-byte AV1 Enhanced RTMP sequence-start as an empty placeholder.
  2. Wait for the later valid av1C before configuring the RTMP AV1 track.
  3. Normalize WebRTC AV1 OBU size fields and base-layer extension headers.
  4. Reconstruct the known libdatachannel <=0.24.3 missing-base-header form.
  5. Drop invalid or enhancement-layer OBUs instead of crashing every HLS reader.
  6. Parse AV1 frame_type, cache the startup sequence header, and restore it only
     before an actual KEY_FRAME when the sender omitted the repeated header.

Encoder requirement:
  HLS/CMAF still requires real random-access frames. In OBS AOM AV1, set
  Keyframe Interval to 1-2 seconds (2 seconds tested). Do not use 0/automatic.
  The server does not transcode and cannot manufacture a missing key frame.

Upstream libdatachannel references (unreleased after v0.24.3 at package time):
  https://github.com/paullouisageneau/libdatachannel/commit/78fea5758e953421c105cd5023b96187c52dcf78
  https://github.com/paullouisageneau/libdatachannel/commit/9822391551f1a7f8cd13a25f87b6b744f963f882

Regression coverage:
  - Raw Enhanced RTMP empty AV1 sequence-start decoding.
  - Empty placeholder followed by a valid av1C track configuration.
  - AV1 OBU size, extension, enhancement-layer, invalid-size, and
    libdatachannel missing-base-header normalization tests.
  - Cached sequence-header restoration only on parsed KEY_FRAME units.
  - OBS-like AOM WHIP publisher that sends the sequence header only once.
  - AV1+Opus LL-HLS six-second decode with 180 decoded video frames.
  - Live 1920x1080 AOM AV1+Opus WHIP, HLS, WHEP, public TLS, and browser tests.

Bundled binary SHA-256:

  arm64  e95a3ac205300c8afacb037aa263d2b53597326e301e6850e46b1b1de431a012
